'''The Cometwash system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

It contained [[The Cometwash]], a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] star surrounded by swarms of [[Comet/Legends|comets]]. This phenomenon made the system become a stopping point for many [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] rechecking their jump calculations after navigating around [[The Roil/Legends|the Roil]] and tourists wanting to catch a glimpse.<ref name="TEA" />
